description.en: Original nominal32cm interpretive rock fragment exposing nested curved conical fracture surfaces and aligned radiating ridges with actual relief, not painted straight scratches or an assembly of pointed cones. Shared direction and primary/secondary surface hierarchy are deliberately readable in gray. Generic impact-related teaching form only, no measured event, locality, pressure, stress direction or precise impact age.
